description: This bar chart illustrates the macro f-score performance for two models, labeled as “RECA” (light orange) and an unlabeled orange model (likely a baseline or alternative method), across three frequency categories: “High,” “Medium,” and “Low,” which are plotted along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled “Macro f-score,” ranges from 0 to 1 in linear increments, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. For each frequency category, two adjacent bars are displayed side-by-side: the left bar represents RECA, and the right bar represents the unlabeled model. In the “High” frequency category, RECA achieves a score of 0.837, while the unlabeled model achieves 0.877. In the “Medium” frequency category, RECA scores 0.538 and the unlabeled model scores 0.609. In the “Low” frequency category, RECA scores 0.114 and the unlabeled model scores 0.224. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the frequency categories from left to right. The legend indicates that the light orange bar corresponds to RECA, and the unlabeled orange bar is visually distinct but lacks a label in the legend. The chart does not include any shaded or annotated bars beyond the numerical values displayed directly on top of each bar.
